errors.text: The central ordering mediator is assigned to B2 domains, whereas the target mechanism is enhanced L12 ordering toward Ni3Al stoichiometry within the FCC phase.
The hypothesis replaces the key jagged B2/FCC phase-boundary morphology and stress concentration at jagged tips with an unsupported coherent-to-incoherent interface transition.
It does not define the specific approximately 550-750°C brittle window, the 600°C ductility minimum, or the 750°C recovery condition.

The cited evidence does not establish cross-slip locking in the relevant ordered domains; E2 concerns SRO effects in BCC MoNbTaW and reports dislocation-type-dependent behavior rather than the claimed mechanism.
